from pathlib import Path
import datetime,json,os,runpy,subprocess,sys,time

p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;repo=p/'source';runtime=p.parent/'context-validation/runtime'
os.umask(0o077)
owned=p/'owned-synthetic';owned.mkdir(mode=0o700,exist_ok=False)
os.environ['POSTGRES_BIN']=str(runtime/'pg/usr/lib/postgresql/18/bin')
os.environ['LD_LIBRARY_PATH']=str(runtime/'pg/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu')
os.environ['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE']='1'
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=repo,text=True).strip()
tree=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'],cwd=repo,text=True).strip()
status=subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],cwd=repo,text=True)
assert head=='f142c9d6b871ebedac133569fc51cb961bbd940f' and not status
argv=[str(repo/'docs/codex-tasks/R18-R26-profile-facts.py'),'--expected-head',head,'--root',str(owned/'sample-001'),'--max-tables','8','--seconds','30']
metadata={'head':head,'tree':tree,'cleanBefore':not status,'entryArgv':['python3',*argv],'wrapperArgv':sys.argv[:],'cwd':str(repo),'syntheticOnly':True,'activationAllowed':False,'instrumentation':'Read-only subprocess timing wrapper; forwards original arguments/results/exceptions. Records command basename/operation, not SQL text or secrets.'}
(p/'execution-metadata.json').write_text(json.dumps(metadata,indent=2))
original_run=subprocess.run

def measured_run(args,*positional,**kwargs):
    name=Path(str(args[0])).name if isinstance(args,(list,tuple)) else 'shell'
    operation=None
    if name=='pg_ctl':operation=next((x for x in args if x in ['start','stop','status']),None)
    if name=='psql':
        if '-f' in args:operation='migration-files'
        elif '-c' in args:
            query=args[args.index('-c')+1]
            operation='copy' if query.startswith('COPY') else 'count' if query.startswith('SELECT count(*)') else 'other-sql'
    if '--version' in args:operation='version'
    data_directory=None
    if '-D' in args:data_directory=str(args[args.index('-D')+1])
    start=time.monotonic();result=None;error=None
    try:
        result=original_run(args,*positional,**kwargs);return result
    except BaseException as exc:
        error=type(exc).__name__;raise
    finally:
        event={'command':name,'operation':operation,'dataDirectory':data_directory,'seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'exit':None if result is None else result.returncode,'errorType':error,'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()}
        with (p/'child-process-events.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(event)+'\n')

subprocess.run=measured_run
sys.argv=argv
started=time.monotonic();code=1
try:
    runpy.run_path(argv[0],run_name='__main__')
except SystemExit as result:
    code=result.code if isinstance(result.code,int) else 1
finally:
    subprocess.run=original_run
    metadata.update(exit=code,seconds=time.monotonic()-started)
    checks={}
    for name in ['synthetic-source','synthetic-restored']:
        root=owned/'sample-001'/name
        pidfile=root/'postgres/postmaster.pid'
        command=[os.environ['POSTGRES_BIN']+'/pg_ctl','-D',str(root/'postgres'),'status']
        result=original_run(command,env=os.environ.copy(),capture_output=True,text=True)
        checks[name]={'directoryExists':root.is_dir(),'postmasterPidExists':pidfile.exists(),'pgCtlStatusExit':result.returncode,'pgCtlStatusOutput':result.stdout+result.stderr}
    metadata['cleanupChecks']=checks
    metadata['cleanAfter']=not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],cwd=repo,text=True).strip()
    (p/'execution-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(metadata,indent=2))
print(json.dumps({'exit':code,'seconds':metadata['seconds'],'cleanupChecks':checks}))
raise SystemExit(code)

from pathlib import Path
import ast,copy,hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys,time,types

p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;repo=p/'source';runtime=p.parent/'context-validation/runtime'
os.umask(0o077);sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
os.environ['POSTGRES_BIN']=str(runtime/'pg/usr/lib/postgresql/18/bin')
os.environ['LD_LIBRARY_PATH']=str(runtime/'pg/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu')
sys.path.insert(0,str(repo/'scripts/local'))
import backup,trial
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=repo,text=True).strip()=='f142c9d6b871ebedac133569fc51cb961bbd940f'
target=p/'owned-synthetic/sample-001/synthetic-restored'
assert not (target/'postgres/postmaster.pid').exists()
profile=repo/'docs/codex-tasks/R18-R26-profile-facts.py'
syntax=ast.parse(profile.read_text())
observe_node=next(x for x in ast.walk(syntax) if isinstance(x,ast.FunctionDef) and x.name=='observe')
factory=ast.parse('''def make_observe(events):
    completed=0
    profile_started=time.monotonic()
    args=types.SimpleNamespace(max_tables=8,seconds=30)
    def emit(event):events.append(event)
    def expire():
        nonlocal profile_started
        profile_started=time.monotonic()-31
    return observe,expire
''')
factory.body[0].body.insert(-1,copy.deepcopy(observe_node))
ast.fix_missing_locations(factory)
class SampleComplete(Exception):pass
class ObserverBudgetStop(Exception):pass
scope={'time':time,'types':types,'SampleComplete':SampleComplete}
exec(compile(factory,str(profile)+'::actual_observe','exec'),scope)
started=time.monotonic();results=[];all_tables=[]
with backup.offline_database(target) as (run,connection,sql):
    all_tables=[x for x in sql("SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public' ORDER BY tablename").splitlines() if x not in backup.TRANSIENT]
    # Only inspect this invocation's new synthetic target; no existing trial or production DB.
    for mode in ['actual_profile_observer_budget_expired','observer_raises_at_sql_failure']:
        events=[];counts={'copyAttempts':0,'countCalls':0};original=[None];child_info={}
        actual_observe,expire=scope['make_observe'](events)
        def adapter(query,fingerprint=False):
            if query.startswith('SELECT count(*)'):counts['countCalls']+=1
            if fingerprint:
                counts['copyAttempts']+=1
                expire() # Exercise the fixed observer with its 30s budget already elapsed.
                failing_query='COPY (SELECT r18_r26_intentionally_missing_column FROM public.accounts) TO STDOUT'
                env={**trial.clean_environment(),'PGPASSWORD':trial.private_read(target/'database.json')['password'],'PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT':'3','PGOPTIONS':'-c statement_timeout=3500'}
                command=[backup.pg('psql'),'-X',*connection,'-qAt','-v','ON_ERROR_STOP=1','-v','VERBOSITY=sqlstate','-c',failing_query]
                child_started=time.monotonic()
                result=subprocess.run(command,env=env,capture_output=True,timeout=5)
                private=p/(mode+'-private-stderr.log');private.write_bytes(result.stderr);private.chmod(0o600)
                child_info.update(exit=result.returncode,seconds=time.monotonic()-child_started,sqlState42703=b'42703' in result.stderr)
                try:result.check_returncode()
                except subprocess.CalledProcessError as error:
                    original[0]=error;raise
                raise AssertionError('The real PostgreSQL error was not raised')
            return sql(query,fingerprint)
        def adversarial_observe(event):
            events.append(event)
            if not event['ok']:raise ObserverBudgetStop()
        case_started=time.monotonic();caught=None;partial_return=False
        try:
            backup.facts(adapter,actual_observe if mode.startswith('actual_') else adversarial_observe)
            partial_return=True
        except BaseException as error:caught=error
        result={'mode':mode,'seconds':time.monotonic()-case_started,'realPGChild':child_info,'originalExceptionIdentityPreserved':caught is original[0] and original[0] is not None,'caughtType':type(caught).__name__,'partialFactsReturned':partial_return,'normalBudgetCompletion':isinstance(caught,SampleComplete),'observerEvents':events,**counts}
        (p/(mode+'-result.json')).write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
        assert child_info['exit']!=0 and child_info['sqlState42703']
        assert result['originalExceptionIdentityPreserved'] and not partial_return and not result['normalBudgetCompletion']
        assert counts=={'copyAttempts':1,'countCalls':0} and events[-1]['ok'] is False
        results.append(result)
status=subprocess.run([backup.pg('pg_ctl'),'-D',str(target/'postgres'),'status'],env=trial.clean_environment(),capture_output=True,text=True)
cleanup={'postmasterPidExists':(target/'postgres/postmaster.pid').exists(),'pgCtlStatusExit':status.returncode,'pgCtlStatusOutput':status.stdout+status.stderr}
assert not cleanup['postmasterPidExists'] and cleanup['pgCtlStatusExit']==3
events=[json.loads(x) for x in (p/'owned-synthetic/sample-001/profile.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
last=next(e for e in reversed(events) if e['phase']=='table_count')
next_table=all_tables[all_tables.index(last['table'])+1] if all_tables.index(last['table'])+1<len(all_tables) else None
report={'head':'f142c9d6b871ebedac133569fc51cb961bbd940f','seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'checks':results,'cleanup':cleanup,'manifestEligibleTableCount':len(all_tables),'lastSampledTable':last['table'],'nextUnmeasuredOperation':{'phase':'table_copy','table':next_table},'actualObserverSourceSHA256':hashlib.sha256(ast.get_source_segment(profile.read_text(),observe_node).encode()).hexdigest(),'scope':'Two intentional real SQL failures in this run-owned synthetic restored target, no migration/dump/restore repeat. Budget expiry is controlled injection; source observer body extracted unchanged from fixed SHA. No full integrity or activation claim.'}
(p/'live-sql-failure-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(report))
